description: The boolean-conversion intrinsic pair FUNCTION BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER (ISO 15.13) / INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN (15.45). LIVE (P11 Step 2): BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER returns a boolean value of argument-2 positions - rightmost position = low-order binary digit, zero-filled or TRUNCATED ON THE LEFT (the result is arg-1 mod 2^arg-2, Annex D.10's 544->low-6-bits worked example) - a boolean function result IS class/category boolean with implicit usage bit (§2023:15.2 GR2: "Boolean functions. These are of the class and category boolean. Boolean functions have an implicit usage bit"); INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN returns the unsigned MSB-first value of the whole bit configuration (15.45.4 r1). Both are COBOL-2002 introductions, with boolean data. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ANSI X3.23-1985 text with its Intrinsic Function amendment (X3.23a-1989) has functions of three types only, §1989:A.2.3: "Data item functions are elementary data items and return alphanumeric, numeric, or integer values", and its Table 1 (§1989:A.2.4: "Table 1 on pages A-30 through A-32 summarizes the functions that are available") lists ACOS through UPPER-CASE, with no boolean type and neither function; §2002:15.11 adds "The BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER function returns a boolean item of usage bit representing the binary value of argument-1" and §2002:15.35 "The INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN function returns the numeric value of the boolean string in argument-1", and §2002:F.2 item 9 states the change: "The following intrinsic functions are provided for processing boolean items: BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER and INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN" (item 78, "New intrinsic functions are", lists both). §2014:15.12 / §2014:15.41 and §2023:15.13.1 / §2023:15.45.1 carry the 2002 sentences unchanged. Below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:F.2 items 9 and 78; the M2 catalog boolean intrinsics)
